title: Umumenyeshamakuru w'Umwuzure Ukomeye
intro: Uyu muntu yabaye inkingi y'ubwihangane mu gihe cy'ibinyejana byinshi, ahamagarira umuryango w'abagome kugana umucyo w'ukuri mu gihe bahanganye n'agasuzuguro n'amahane. Nubwo hari ingorane nyinshi n'uburemere bw'ubutumwa bwagiye bugera ku bisekuru, uyu mugaragu yakomeje gushikama mu butumwa bwe kugeza igihe itegeko rya nyuma ryasohowe.
clues: Namaze imyaka magana icyenda na mirongo itanu nhamagarira abantu banjye inzira yo gukiranuka, ku manywa na nijoro, mu ibanga no mu ruhame.
Naburiye abantu banjye igihano kibabaza, nyamara bishyize intoki zabo mu matwi yabo kandi bitwikira imyenda yabo mu bwibone.
Nategetswe kubaka ikintu kinini imbere y'Uwiteka wanjye, nubwo nta mazi yari ahari.
Ubwo nakoraga, abayobozi b'ubwoko bwanjye baranyuraga baranseka, ariko nababwiye ko vuba aha tuzaba ari twe tubaseka.
Nasabye umubiri wanjye n'amaraso yanjye kuza kuri njye, ariko bahisemo guhungira ku musozi, bizera ko uzabakiza umuraba wari urimo kwiyongera.
Ubwato bwanjye bwaje guhagarara ku musozi wa Judi nyuma y’uko isi irangije kumira amazi n’ijuru rihagarika imvura.
arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
